state.unknown_yet: Press the button a few more times

watch.name: Watch the airwaves
watch.description: Listens in RAW mode and reports accepted captures. Each accepted capture fires an rfxcom_commands_raw event. Incomplete or unsupported signals may be received without producing a code. Normal protocol decoding is interrupted during capture.

options.button: Button - press it to send the command once
options.switch: Switch - one RF code toggles both on and off

user.title: RFXCOM Commands
user.description: This uses the connection your RFXCOM integration already has, so there is nothing to configure. Press Submit, then add commands from the integration page.

abort.already_configured: Already set up. Add commands from the integration page.
abort.no_gateway: No RFXCOM integration is set up. Add that first: this integration borrows its connection to the device rather than opening a second one.

init.title: Watch the airwaves
init.description:
Reports accepted RAW captures and packet counts during a bounded listening window. A received signal may still be rejected if its frames are incomplete, inconsistent or unsupported.

Normal protocol decoding is interrupted while listening. Stop any other scanner or learning session first.

progress.listening: Listening. Press the buttons you want to see.

user.title: Learn a command
user.description:
Press Submit, then press the button on your remote, within a few metres of the RFXCOM.

This closes itself as soon as it recognises the command. If nothing happens, press again -- there is time.

name.title: Name the command
name.description:
Captured `{hex}`

`{bits}`

{quality}. Found {frames} agreeing frames. Replay uses that count, capped at ten; the captured burst may be shorter than the full physical press.

The entity will be created as `{entity_id}`.

Tick Test to transmit and observe the appliance. Nothing is saved while Test is checked.

data_description.kind: Use Switch only if the same RF code toggles both ways. Separate ON/OFF codes need two buttons. Switch state is assumed; repeated ON or OFF calls still transmit.

reconfigure.title: Edit command
reconfigure.description: Renaming or moving the command keeps the same entity, so dashboards and automations carry on working.

data_description.entity_id: The entity this command drives. Read-only; select it to copy.
data_description.kind: Changing this replaces the entity, so anything pointing at the old one needs updating.
data_description.test: Transmits the command straight away so you can check it still works. Nothing is saved while this is ticked.

progress.learn: Press the button on your remote now.
